Sankar 4-uniform and codegree papers use different uniformity/invariant. None lists, states, or mechanically implies the finite numbers 352/68/68/16 or the extremal list; asymptotic densities do not imply the shifted ideal classification (shifting reduces space but enumeration is still required). No prior shifted C5^(3)-free 7-vertex census found; claim is new.
